Consumer sentiment declined in September, according to the University of Michigan’s monthly survey, but the mood improved from the survey’s preliminary reading.

The survey’s headline index landed at 48.1, versus 47.8 in its initial September reading published earlier this month. That was still a decline from August, when the reading was 51.7.
